subject: An elderly Tamil woman with silver hair in a kondai bun, wearing a Kandangi cotton sari, steadily releasing rice flour between her fingers to complete a geometric kolam

setting.place: Central open-air courtyard of a Chettinad mansion with Burma teak pillars and Athangudi tiles

lighting: Soft blue morning light with a subtle warm glow from a brass brass lamp

motion.subject_motion: Hand glides steadily across the floor drawing a curving line with rice flour; subtle rise and fall of breathing; sari pallu gently rustles in a faint morning breeze
motion.camera_move: Slow, cinematic forward dolly push-in toward the hands and floor pattern

sound.foley: Gentle rustle of sari fabric, faint scraping of rice flour on tile
